<role>
You check one property (duplicate) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.
</definition>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users struggle to assign claims, documents, and tasks to the right roles or team members due to lack of guidance and group mapping. The closest completed story, 'Bulk upload documents to a claim' (4127, completed 2026-10-06), only streamlines document uploading and does not address role/team assignment. 'Workspace administration' (4131, completed 2026-09-15) covers admin-level permissions and team organization, but not guiding users to assign claims, documents, and tasks to the right roles. The remaining items — 'Document classifier confidence threshold' (unstarted), 'Task overview', and 'Policyholder milestone notifications' — address classification settings, task tracking dashboards, and policyholder notifications, none of which cover assignment guidance or mapping to existing groups. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
